description: Use when you want a shortlist of TapeOut rigs to consider buying, before calling buy. TapeOut mining rigs on BNB Chain listed now below their fair price (median BNB price of recent sales of the same CPU and mining power), only where the fair price rests on at least 3 sales (raise minSales for stricter results; every item shows its sales count). Each item: price, fair, sales, hours, underFairPct and a buy link on owlgate.xyz (the buyer signs in their own wallet; OwlGate adds a 0.75% fee). Deepest discount first. Estimate, not advice; listings can sell at any time.
